create: CREATE TABLE backend_regions (account_id TEXT, storage_id TEXT, region_id BLOB, resource_type INT, backend_region_state INT, backend_region_current_resource_set_id BLOB, backend_region_processing_resource_set_id BLOB, backend_region_target_resource_set_id BLOB, backend_region_participating_in_update INT, backend_region_ever_active_in_update INT, serialized_backend_region BLOB, PRIMARY KEY (account_id, storage_id, region_id, resource_type) )

CREATE TABLE cross_instance_keyed_protos (keyed_proto_type INT , serialized_keyed_proto BLOB, PRIMARY KEY (keyed_proto_type) )
CREATE TABLE debug_history (account_id TEXT, storage_id TEXT, debug_history_message TEXT, timestamp INT)
CREATE TABLE debug_infos (account_id TEXT, storage_id TEXT, debug_key TEXT, debug_value BLOB, timestamp INT, PRIMARY KEY (account_id, storage_id, debug_key) )

CREATE TABLE offline_backends (account_id TEXT, storage_id TEXT, resource_type INT, offline_backend BLOB, PRIMARY KEY (account_id, storage_id, resource_type) )

CREATE TABLE regions (account_id TEXT, storage_id TEXT, region_id BLOB, region_state INT DEFAULT NULL, serialized_region BLOB, owner_user_id BLOB, owner_account_id BLOB, priority INT, connectivity_constraint INT, PRIMARY KEY (account_id, storage_id, region_id) )

CREATE TABLE resource_mapping (account_id TEXT, storage_id TEXT, mapping_resource_set_id BLOB, resource_type INT, resource_id BLOB, PRIMARY KEY (account_id, storage_id, mapping_resource_set_id, resource_type, resource_id) )
CREATE TABLE resource_verifications (account_id TEXT, storage_id TEXT, serialized_resource_verification BLOB, PRIMARY KEY (account_id, storage_id, serialized_resource_verification) )

CREATE TABLE resources (account_id TEXT, storage_id TEXT, resource_type INT, resource_id BLOB, resource_state INT, resource_failure_reason INT, resource_full_url TEXT, resource_diff_url TEXT, serialized_resource BLOB, resource_diff_source_id BLOB DEFAULT '', PRIMARY KEY (account_id, storage_id, resource_type, resource_id) )
CREATE TABLE visited_tiles (account_id TEXT, storage_id TEXT, tile_coordinate INT, location_timestamp INT, interaction_timestamp INT, PRIMARY KEY (account_id, storage_id, tile_coordinate) )
